name: Poojaa Precision Engg. Limited
about: Poojaa Precision Engg. Limited, a precision engineering company, manufactures and sells aluminium die casting and machining components for use in the automotive sector in India. The company's automotive products include intake mainfolds, cylinder head covers, EGR housing components, camshaft carriers, clutch housings, oil filter holders, intake mainfolds assembly, elbow assembly; electronic vehicle products, such as covers, transmission casings, application, oil pump covers, and housing bearing sleeve assembly; and non-automotive products includes base lower section, casted tubes, horizontal slides, c-arc holders, filter heads, rocker arms, pipemeters body, FA1, conductors, and contact carriers. The company serves electric vehicle applications and the non-automotive sector, covering agriculture, defence, energy, healthcare, engineering goods industry; original equipment manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers operating in the domestic market. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Pune, India.
